name: Delete (reset) DLP account-level settings to initial values.
description: Delete (reset) DLP account-level settings to initial values. Deletes account-level DLP settings and returns the initial values. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
Deletes account-level DLP settings and returns the initial values.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Partially update DLP account-level settings.
description: Partially update DLP account-level settings. Missing fields keep their existing values. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
Missing fields keep their existing values.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — DLP settings fields to update.

name: Get DLP account-level settings.
description: Get DLP account-level settings. Gets the account-level DLP settings. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
Gets the account-level DLP settings.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update DLP account-level settings (full replacement).
description: Update DLP account-level settings (full replacement). Missing fields are reset to initial (unconfigured) values. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/settings
Missing fields are reset to initial (unconfigured) values.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — New DLP settings.
